title: Time stratum 1 is simultaneously defined as mesh-derived and local-source quality
description: Correctness review: spec/09-packets-timing.md:303-312 defines wire stratum 1 Meaning=Mesh-derived, Source Class=Network(peer DIO). Lines 324-330 then require direct manual, initialized RTC, and non-gpsd Local-client samples to use stratum 1 while explicitly forbidding relabeling them as mesh provenance. packets-timing.json time_sync_stratum and generate_packets_timing.py:689-704 retain the name MESH_DERIVED while listing Network, Local-client, Manual/static, and Internal RTC. Although prose says stratum does not infer provenance, the normative Meaning and enum-style vector name do exactly that. Rename the quality level to provenance-neutral terminology and align the table/vector so implementations do not reject or misattribute valid local stratum-1 samples.
